nonblocking_findings: F3 [Nit] review-a: dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:295-297 and :325-327 check folder existence before a recursive mkdir. Concurrent requests can both pass that check and write project.json. Rationale: the new guard protects sequential duplicate creation but does not provide exclusive creation. An in-memory probe of the actual implementation returned two fulfilled creates and two writes. Use an exclusive directory creation step and add a concurrent-create test when this guard changes next.
